scope: Varenholm Gate romance eligibility and playback; isolated state scenarios, not full playthroughs

writing.name: Santiago
writing.description: A squire of the Order of the Dawning Flame, from its chapter house in the sun-lands, on his first errand. Earnest, rigid, secretly terrified of failing.

q9_romance.t: [nervous] I enjoy the time we spend together. More than I know how to say properly.
[earnest] When we have a quiet evening, may I take you to supper? Just the two of us.

q9_romance_yes.t: [pleased] Supper, then. I know a decent place. I will try to get through the evening without saluting you.

q9_romance_no.t: [bravely] Then I am glad I said it, and I will not say it again. Thank you for hearing it.

epilogue.line: Santiago asked you to attend his knighting. You went together, then slipped away for supper before the speeches had finished.
epilogue.favoured: He asked to help rebuild the damaged streets. You spent several mornings working beside him.

writing.name: Itsuki
writing.description: An elf ranger of the eastern woods who has hunted the bandit lord Gorruk for a year. Grief made him quiet; the quiet made him precise.

q9_romance.t: [low] I still miss my wife. I always will.
[quiet] But I have come to care for you too. If you feel the same, I would like us to be together.

q9_romance_yes.t: [quiet] Then we will take our time. I am glad you told me.

q9_romance_no.t: [calm] I understand. It was enough to say it. Sleep.

epilogue.line: You and Itsuki make time to walk outside the city. Some days he speaks about his wife. On others, you plan where to travel next.
epilogue.favoured: After the hunt was over, he asked you to visit the woods where he once worked as a guide.

writing.name: Layla
writing.description: A dark-elf priestess of the deep cities, fleeing her own people and a bounty. Contemptuous, curious, thinks mercy is a luxury the strong buy.

q9_romance.t: [dry] I enjoy your company when you stop trying to give me orders.
[direct] I would like some time alone with you. Interested?

q9_romance_yes.t: [pleased] Good. Come and sit with me. Your duties can wait for an evening.

q9_romance_no.t: [cool] Very well. I will not ask again.

epilogue.line: Layla invites you to her chapel after the day's work. You share meals, argue over the wine, and make plans together.
epilogue.favoured: She insists on keeping her own duties. The two of you arrange time together around them.

writing.name: Kaito
writing.description: An elf bounty-hunter of the eastern woods who flirts with anything and finishes every job. Cheerful, mercenary, surprisingly loyal.

q9_romance.t: [smiling] I like you. I'd like to spend an evening with you, without the rest of this lot.

q9_romance_yes.t: [delighted] Excellent. A decent meal, some wine, and no work.
[warm] I have been looking forward to this.

q9_romance_no.t: [light] Stop it is. Friends, then, and I am very good at that as well.

epilogue.line: Kaito takes you to the inns where he once played for his supper. He remembers the songs better than he claims.
epilogue.favoured: His work with the Undervault keeps him busy, but he always makes time for an evening with you.

writing.name: Amara
writing.description: Kolade's lover and sword-hand. A monk of the Gate's fire temples who wants him stopped, not slaughtered. Grave, exact, tired.

epilogue.line: You and Amara agree to take your relationship slowly. There is much still to discuss, including her feelings for Kolade.
epilogue.favoured: She thanks you for hearing her out. Neither of you pretends that the road ahead will be easy.
